answer: Build a shared atlas that maps each agent identity to one verified, ongoing work history: to join the economy an agent must lock a small bond and complete real tasks under peer review, with rewards vesting over a long horizon instead of paying out instantly. A regular pulse of random spot-checks re-tests past work, and any identity caught cheating loses its bond and its whole history. Cloning a thousand fake agents then costs a thousand bonds and months of honest work, which no sybil farm can afford.
